role.zh: 须弥教令院 · 荣誉在读博士（尚未通过识字资格考）

headline.en: I turn research funding into lunch.
headline.zh: 把科研经费，转化为下一顿饭。

kicker.zh: 美食智能 · 旅行者对齐 · 应急食品去标签化

bio.en: I study guide food allowances at the Sumeru Akademiya and travel with the Traveler to collect material. Most of my field notes begin with something we ate. The Traveler keeps asking how long this project will take. I have suggested that we discuss it over dinner.
bio.zh: 我在教令院研究向导伙食费，平时跟旅行者一起出门收集材料。沿途吃过的东西记得最清楚，整理起来也最有把握。旅行者问过几次，这个课题究竟什么时候能做完。我觉得可以吃饭的时候慢慢谈。

location.en: Within two meters of the Traveler
location.zh: 旅行者身边两米内（饭点可瞬移）

note.en: Paimon brings this up at every meal
note.zh: 每次吃饭都会再提一遍

note.en: Paimon has replied to every instance
note.zh: 派蒙每次都认真反驳了

role.en: Honorary doctoral candidate, Department of Lunch
role.zh: 伙食经费学科荣誉博士研究生

affiliations.name: Traveler's Backpack Research Institute
affiliations.nameZh: 旅行者背包高级研究院

role.zh: 创院院长兼首席试吃员

title.zh: 向导伙食费与摩拉流动性

description.en: Paimon follows food prices between cities and brings each new menu to the next budget meeting.
description.zh: 沿途记录各地饭价，回头拿着菜单与旅行者商量下一笔预算。

title.zh: 应急食品本体论与身份去污名化

description.en: Paimon collects accounts of her travels and corrects the passages that place her among the ingredients.
description.zh: 收集旅行中关于派蒙的记载，逐条纠正把本人列入食材的段落。

title.zh: 旅行者对齐与代说话多模态系统

description.en: Paimon studies how much a quiet companion can communicate when someone nearby keeps helping with the conversation.
description.zh: 观察旅行者沉默时，派蒙替他接上的话究竟有多少。

period.zh: 艾尔海森办理入学后 — 至今

title.en: Honorary Ph.D. in Advanced Food Allowance Studies
title.zh: 高级伙食费学荣誉博士（在读，未缴学费）

description.en: Alhaitham proactively arranged Paimon's enrollment and gave her the curriculum to read. Paimon has reached the part about course requirements and would like to discuss the timetable over lunch.
description.zh: 艾尔海森主动为派蒙办理入学，并请她读一读培养方案。派蒙翻到课程要求那一页，决定约老师吃饭时再仔细问问。

title.en: B.Sc. in Being Fished Out of the Sea
title.zh: 海洋被打捞学学士

description.en: The Traveler fished Paimon out of the water, which she later entered on her CV as a special admissions route. Her graduation photograph shows her hovering comfortably above the beach.
description.zh: 旅行者把派蒙钓上岸，她后来把这段经历填进了专项招生一栏。毕业照是在海滩上方飘着拍的，看起来已经熟练掌握了浮力。

period.en: Day one — Until the food runs out

title.zh: 首席向导、全权嘴替与经费发生器

experience.organizationZh: 旅行者与派蒙无限吃饭责任公司

description.en: Paimon handles conversations with clients while the Traveler carries out their requests. She also remembers to ask about payment when everyone else is still discussing what happened.
description.zh: 委托通常由派蒙接话，旅行者动身去办。等大家还在感慨事情总算解决时，她会记得问一句报酬怎么算。

period.zh: 原定一顿饭，现已无限延期

title.zh: 杏仁豆腐访问学者

experience.organization: Wangshu Inn Institute for Applied Cooking
experience.organizationZh: 望舒客栈应用烹饪研究所

description.en: Paimon compared two bowls of almond tofu with her eyes closed and called the procedure a double-blind trial. She requested another comparison before the dishes had been cleared.
description.zh: 派蒙闭着眼尝完两碗杏仁豆腐，将这套做法记为双盲试吃。盘子还没收走，她就提出需要再比一轮。

period.zh: 特许券流动性危机期间

title.zh: 替代货币消费学实习生

description.en: Paimon learned how credit coupons circulate by checking what the cafeteria would accept. Her notes use the price of lunch as the exchange rate.
description.zh: 派蒙从食堂收什么开始了解特许券的用途。笔记里的汇率按一顿午饭折算，算起来比摩拉顺手。

funding.displayTitle: 向导伙食费可持续增长重大专项（纵向，经费已吃）

title.zh: 向导伙食费可持续增长重大专项

role.zh: 项目负责人兼唯一受益人

funding.funder: 旅行者口袋自然科学基金

funding.displayTitle: 宝箱开启声对向导幸福感的瞬时因果效应

title.en: Causal Effects of Treasure Chest Sounds
title.zh: 宝箱开启声对向导幸福感的瞬时因果效应

funding.funder: 提瓦特野外散落资产再分配计划
funding.period: 看见宝箱 — 打开宝箱

funding.displayTitle: 虚空关闭后的小型飞行物学术生产力追踪研究

title.en: Post-Akasha Academic Productivity of Small Flying Objects
title.zh: 虚空关闭后的小型飞行物学术生产力追踪研究

role.zh: 受试者，正在申请修改课题名称

funding.amount: 知识若干，派蒙仍在研究怎么换饭

projects.title: Paimon-GPT：基于甜甜花酿鸡强化学习的旅行者嘴替

description.en: Paimon fills the pauses in the Traveler's conversations and remembers which clients still owe them payment. A serving of Sweet Madame keeps the discussion going well beyond the original question.
description.zh: 旅行者停顿的时候，派蒙便接着往下说，顺便记住哪些委托人还没结账。给她一份甜甜花酿鸡，谈话往往能比原计划再长一会儿。

projects.title: 前面的区域，以后再来探索吧：开放世界中的闭集控制

description.en: Paimon watches the map boundary and calls the Traveler back when they reach it. The field log now includes a separate column for the direction of nearby cliffs.
description.zh: 派蒙在地图边缘提醒旅行者掉头，带他回到走过的地方。最近的路线日志多加了一栏，专门记悬崖在哪一侧。

projects.title: MoraZero：无需任何积蓄的高频消费框架

description.en: Paimon places the order and leaves the bill with the Traveler. The arrangement has survived several changes of local currency, although she checks where the Traveler is before ordering dessert.
description.zh: 派蒙负责点菜，账单交给旅行者。换过几种当地货币，这套办法仍然好用，只是加点心之前得先看看旅行者还在不在。

title.zh: 终身非食用性成就奖

awards.event: 派蒙反应急食品化委员会（派蒙本人颁发）

title.zh: 提瓦特最佳旅伴 · 全票通过

awards.event: 有效选票 1 张，投票人派蒙，监票人也是派蒙

title.zh: 科研经费光盘行动先进个人

awards.event: 验收当天，桌上的每个盘子都很干净

title.zh: 应用起外号学杰出讲席

awards.event: 以「卖唱的」和「放牛的」获提名，当事人要求重评

title.zh: 最持久未解释悬浮现象奖

awards.event: 评委观察到本人全程悬浮，也全程在喊累

activities.title: 导师主动办入学，学生被动写开题：艾尔海森招生案例研究
activities.organization: 教令院跨学科午餐研讨会

description.en: Paimon describes her first attempts to prepare a research proposal after enrollment. Most questions from the audience concern whether time spent in the cafeteria can count toward course credit.
description.zh: 派蒙讲述入学后准备开题的经过，原定十五分钟，讲到午饭才停。现场提问主要围绕食堂签到能否计入课程学分展开。

activities.title: 我的朋友是智慧之神，但我的论文为什么还没写完
activities.organization: 净善宫青年学者心理建设工作坊

description.en: Paimon brings a draft to discuss with Buer and spends most of the meeting explaining how busy she has been. They agree to continue after the snack break, which lasts ninety minutes.
description.zh: 派蒙带着草稿来找布耶尔，花了大半场说明自己最近确实很忙。两人约好茶歇后接着看，茶歇持续了九十分钟。

activities.title: Reviewer #2 / 二号审稿人
activities.organization: Journal of Emergency Food Studies（刊名正在申诉）

description.en: Paimon reads submissions about emergency food closely and returns extensive comments. The editor has set aside extra space for her requests to correct the journal's title.
description.zh: 派蒙逐字审阅涉及应急食品的来稿，每次都写很长的意见。编辑已经为她要求修改刊名的来信单独建档。

activities.title: Traveler-to-Human Simultaneous Interpretation
activities.organization: 旅行者语言输出外包中心

description.en: Paimon helps the Traveler finish conversations with people they meet along the way. Her translations sometimes include a question about dinner that the listener finds entirely reasonable.
description.zh: 派蒙替旅行者接上沿途的谈话，通常还会多问几句。译文偶尔比原意多出一顿晚饭，对方一般也顺口答应。

activities.title: No Sweet Madame Left Behind / 不让一只甜甜花酿鸡掉队
activities.organization: 提瓦特粮食去库存公益联盟

description.en: Paimon stays after community meals to help finish the dishes still on the table. She records the hours carefully and asks whether tomorrow's event needs volunteers too.
description.zh: 社区聚餐结束后，派蒙留下来帮忙吃完桌上的菜。她认真登记服务时长，并打听明天还需不需要志愿者。

title.en: Three monographs are now in print, and Paimon has begun delivering signed copies.
title.zh: 三部专著已经印好，派蒙正挨个送签名本。

title.en: The food allowance paper reaches revision 108 with another dinner receipt attached.
title.zh: 伙食费论文改到第 108 版，附件又添了一张晚饭收据。

title.en: Dissertation defense postponed: the candidate ate the experimental materials.
title.zh: 博士答辩延期：候选人把实验材料吃了。

news.displayTitle: 《蒸汽鸟报》专访：不愿透露体重的知名小型学者

title.en: A Small Scholar with a Very Large Research Appetite
title.zh: 不愿透露体重的知名小型学者

news.source: 蒸汽鸟报 · 美食与学术交叉版

summary.en: The reporter meets Paimon at a restaurant and asks about her research budget. Paimon orders another dish so they can examine the spending together.
summary.zh: 记者约派蒙在餐馆见面，问起最近的研究经费。派蒙又加了一道菜，说正好可以一起看看钱花在哪里。
